title: (2025 OCT) Cumulative Updates for Business Central
summary: Cumulative updates for Business Central versions 26, 25, and 24 are released regularly to fix vulnerabilities and hotfixes. The latest updates should always be installed, with older versions no longer receiving updates after they exit support.
key_points: Update 26.6 for v26, Update 25.12 for v25, and Update 24.18 for v24 are the latest cumulative releases
Updates include hotfixes for all countries plus country-specific local versions
Versions 23 and earlier no longer receive updates
Latest updates should always be installed due to vulnerability fixes

quotes.text: Some updates additionally fix vulnerabilities, so the latest update should always be installed.
quotes.why_it_matters: Indicates the critical importance of staying current with updates for security reasons

quotes.text: Updates include hotfixes that apply to all countries and hotfixes that apply to specific local versions.
quotes.why_it_matters: Clarifies that updates cover both global and localization-specific fixes
